parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const x=$input.first()?.json||{};const p=x.payload||{};const t=v=>String(v??'').normalize('NFKC').trim();const raw=t(x.requestType||x.operation).toLowerCase();const operation=raw==='delete_confirm'?'delete':(raw==='delete_preview'?'preview':raw);const storageUsername=t(x.storageUsername||p.storage_username||p.storageUsername);const tenantId=t(x.tenantId||p.tenant_id||p.tenantId||(storageUsername?`tenant_${storageUsername}`:''));const requestId=t(x.requestId||p.request_id||p.requestId);if(!['export','preview','delete'].includes(operation))throw new Error('privacy_files_invalid_operation');if(!/^actor_[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(storageUsername)||tenantId!==`tenant_${storageUsername}`)throw new Error('privacy_files_identity_contract_invalid');if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,160}$/.test(requestId))throw new Error('privacy_files_request_id_invalid');return [{json:{...x,requestType:operation,requestId,storageUsername,tenantId,adapter:'files'}}];

parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const req=$('Code | Validate Restricted Files Privacy Request | PrivacyFiles').first().json;let r={};try{r=JSON.parse(String($json.stdout||'{}').trim())}catch{throw new Error('privacy_files_receipt_invalid_json')};if(r.success!==true||r.operation!==req.requestType)throw new Error(`privacy_files_adapter_failed:${r.error||'invalid_receipt'}`);if(req.requestType==='preview'&&(r.mutated!==false||!(Number(r.sourceEntries)>=0)||!(Number(r.sourceBytes)>=0)))throw new Error('privacy_files_preview_not_verified_non_destructive');if(req.requestType==='delete'&&r.verifiedAbsent!==true)throw new Error('privacy_files_delete_not_verified');if(req.requestType==='export'&&(!r.archivePath||!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(String(r.sha256))||!(Number(r.bytes)>=0)||Number(r.archiveEntries)<Number(r.sourceEntries)))throw new Error('privacy_files_export_receipt_incomplete');return [{json:{adapter:'files',success:true,retryable:false,receipt:{contractVersion:'chelsea_files_privacy_receipt_v3',...r,requestId:req.requestId,tenantId:req.tenantId,completedAt:new Date().toISOString()},errorMessage:''}}];
